description: Part-to-whole as nested rectangles whose areas show share of the total, laid out by the squarified treemap algorithm (d3-hierarchy treemapSquarify). By default up to four categories: each category is one block and its items are rectangles inside it, with the category name and total in a pill. With an optional per-item path (1 to 3 group names, top down) the chart nests by that path instead, up to three levels of group boxes with a header showing the group name and total, so a folder tree or a cost breakdown reads like a disk-usage map. Each rectangle carries its name and value where the drawn width and height can hold them; in a narrower container or a thin cell the label is hidden (the hover title and the hidden table keep it). A hidden table gives item, category (or path), value and share. Motion-ready: every moving value reads --p (build progress 0 to 1, default 1) through a per-item --k, so a motion_timeline track on p builds it item by item and the standalone render is the finished picture; reduced motion shows the end state.
